column2: #男愛称's seat... The seat...!!
#男愛称! We'll be immobilized in 34 seconds! Destroy Medius, quickly!!
...#男愛称, are you feeling all right?
...How is #男愛称 doing...?
...I'm sorry... #男愛称.
...Being single is hard on both of us, isn't it?
...Wh-what do we do, #男愛称!?
...Honestly. You're younger than me, yet you aren't cute at all.
...All right. I'll run a simulation.
...Dr. Zapato, right?
...The TE limiter?
Ah... I-I'm sorry.
Um...
Why would you do something like that...!?
N-no...!! This can't... It can't be!!
Yes. As your partner, I'll do what I can... so we can get results together.
Right! If it becomes a long-range fight, leave it to my Form S!
I-I'm sorry... I... I...!
I-I'm sorry... I said such awful things to you without knowing any of that...
Th-then...!
You're sorry...? You...
Th-the front seat... It's been... crushed!!
That's not it... I don't intend to die...
That's right! I'm not getting out until we get proper results!
You only just recovered, like Akito. Your body still needs time.
Then what happens to the TE Engine's output adjustments?
And... what's the new unit called?
Even so... I...
And what are these optional parts?
And what are those wolf and bird machines?
Besides, don't you have some connection to Ms. Eldeh Mitte, Doctor?
I know that perfectly well.
Never mind that! What's wrong!? You're deathly pale!
I can't do that!
This isn't a little risk! We could end up unable to move!
It's just... I want to talk to my teacher again...
Hey! Where are you going!? Wait!
B-but... She stole Medius... She became my enemy...
B-but your body...!
B-but I don't know...! I can't predict it!!
B-but I can't! I can't fight my teacher!
Still, take it easy for a while, all right?
What should I do...? I...!
Wh-why...? Why...? Why would my teacher do that...?
Then why won't you get examined? Don't tell me you're afraid of needles!
H-hey, are you really all right? Shouldn't you go to the infirmary?
Yes, yes. I'm just a co-pilot with hardly any combat experience.
Don't give me that! You always tell me to leave piloting #機体名 and fighting to you!
If something else happens, you might have to pilot #機体名 again...
A-all right! I'm disengaging the limiter!!
I-I don't know...! So much has happened...!
All right. Whatever happens, Medius has to...!
All right! Deploying Terminus Energy absorption plates! Opening the bypass!
D-Dr. Zapato...! Why are you aboard the Nadesico!?
Medius has stopped moving...! This is our chance, #男愛称!!
So you're just going to shrug it off!? Now I'm furious! I'll stay aboard out of sheer spite!
Why would my teacher do this to me...!?
What's with that attitude!? Who do you think you are!?
Why do I have to fight my teacher...!?
I'll talk to her... If that doesn't work, then...
No way! I'll show you I can do my job properly!
It's fine. I promised Rain, too.
Orders...? But Dr. Zapato isn't here anymore...!
It transforms...!
Finding out we've been sitting on a bomb... That's no joke!
The unit's shape is changing...!
Confirm...? You...
What... should I do...!?
I... I don't know what to do...!
I'm a TE Absorber pilot starting today, too, you know?
I don't want to put it behind me... My teacher... My relationship with her...
Disengage it...!? That'll overheat the engine, won't it?
Training? Is that acquaintance the commander of your old special forces unit?
Answer me!! #男愛称!!!
The TE Engine's output is stable! We're going after Medius!
! Repairs...!?
#女愛称...
#女愛称, full TE Engine output! Don't let it drop into the yellow zone!
#女愛称! Don't let him distract you! The output's entering the yellow zone!!
...Very well. We'll take charge of the new unit.
...No, it's fine. The rest...
...I'm sorry. I never meant to deceive you or the others...
...It seems there's more going on behind this than we thought.
...Testing the temperamental units before Medius required a strong body.
...It's all or nothing. #女愛称, disengage the TE limiter!
...What do you want?
...An acquaintance of mine is fond of Japan.
...I am fighting.
...If you've got a complaint, I'll end our partnership anytime. Get out of #機体名.
...Are you trying to get yourself killed?
Y-yeah...!
Yeah... When the Cry Wolves fought the Devil Gundam... I was mortally wounded.
Yeah, it's impossible...!
Yeah. Albero, Eldeh, Medius... He's behind all of them.
Yeah. More to the point, it's #機体名's first battle...
Who is that woman?
Don't think everything will go your way!
Just control the output!!
I understand how you feel about Eldeh Mitte after what you said earlier.
G-ugh...!
And that power Medius has... Are you hiding something from us?
Otherwise, the Cry Wolves who died will never rest in peace...
That's not it. I'm actually rather fond of it.
Right. Simulate the unit's condition with it disengaged.
That's right. All right, let's go!
And you should have left the battlefield to mourn my comrades and your son!
Then you'll have to steel yourself.
Besides... Whatever started this, I joined the project of my own free will.
And now even the project itself looks suspicious...!
Besides, I have my duties as a member of #部隊名!
Besides, the transformed Medius is too dangerous...
I also trained at a Zen temple nearby as part of my training.
Don't worry about that, either. Broken parts can be replaced. Just like an MS or super robot.
I wanted to pass those things on to the next generation.
Do I look that much like a child?
Don't look so miserable. As you can see, I'm alive.
But it should raise the output temporarily.
But we don't know how she feels about you.
It's like a mild seizure. It happens sometimes.
Then that's fine.
More or less.
I-I'm all right now... Sorry...
All right! Disengage the TE limiter!
All right. Then let's get my body "repaired" soon.
I know! Adjust the output again!
Tch, planning to sit back and watch...! Bastard!
The bridge. I'll confirm the mission details with Lieutenant Douglas.
That wasn't in the project's specifications.
To bring down Medius Locus.
To Rain...?
As our battles have shown, as long as it has Lasmunanium...
This time, I'm here to destroy you for good.
That's... what I think.
I'm fighting Albero Esto to survive.
I was shaken when I learned the commander was piloting Medius, too...
If you can't accept it, you'll die.
I knew there'd be some risk.
I knew there'd be some risk.
They have no intention of being friendly. If we don't fight, they'll kill us.
I don't want a lecture. Give me stronger medicine.
Focus on the battle, #女愛称! Show an opening and they'll get you!!
My medicine...! My medicine...
Focus. Don't get careless just because adjusting the output has gotten easier.
Unit 8...!?
I'd heard about Unit 8, but your timing in bringing it here is a little too good.
Unit 9...!?
I'd heard about Unit 9, but your timing in bringing it here is a little too good.
...My arms and legs still move. I'll manage...!
Damn, the medicine... It's gradually losing its effect...
Damn it! If only my hand had moved back then...!
At this rate... I won't be able to move my limbs properly much longer...
It's her first real battle... No wonder she's nervous, but...
A new unit......
Impossible...! My medicine shouldn't have worn off yet...!
Black Sarena...!
You never get tired of this, do you...? It's been three days already.
We must never forget that the bonds between people give us strength.
Whoever obtains every Data Weapon shall become the king of the universe...
If you can't forgive me, do as you please once this battle is over. But for now...
Is that how it works?
If you won't fight me, die here. What's the point of living in that body?
Defeat the enemy we must defeat and return alive. Everything else... comes after that.
Your unit's movements are sluggish. Has your medicine worn off?
You must have been lucky enough to cheat death.
Could it be... you heard that #機体名 was destroyed...?
You're safe... Thank goodness...!
...I believe it's a side effect of the medicine.
Yes, if he takes more than the prescribed dose at once.
And he hasn't received Dr. Zapato's adjustments lately, has he?
Dr. Zapato contacted us. He says he'll give him new medicine.
My staff has drunk human blood, and my soul has drunk human lives...
I'm honored by your praise! In return, I'll give you a taste of my broadsword!
Hey! Everyone, we're back!
Looks like they've already hit it off with people their own age.
What's next...? The Federation took the Giganos moon base, right? Is there more?
To put it simply... I helped her draw manga...
The bombers will enter the airspace over Tokyo-3 shortly!
Toji! Toji, answer me!!
Yeah. This is the infirmary, you know?
But what happened? Your hand suddenly stopped moving...
Yes...
Yes, he's in charge of developing #機体名.
Even if you have the seventh, I shall not lose!
If you intend to take me down with you, it's futile... Altair.
Yeah. Having a family really is nice...
Still, he's one tough guy.
What's he doing coming here now?
It's amazing he survived nearly being crushed inside the cockpit.
Oh, right. Just to be clear, don't get your hopes up.
He's really not going to show up here.
We were just looking for somewhere to move to.
All units are in position.
Wh... What!?
What...!?
Answer me! What are you planning to do with Dendoh and the Data Weapons!?
! R-really!?
I'd like your cooperation in bringing this war to a swift conclusion.
I think #女愛称 is safe, but #男愛称...!
H-he was crushed between the console and the seat by Medius Locus's attack...
W-we managed to recover them...
Y-yes.
Hm? This is... Captain, a Federation transport is requesting permission to land.
Hmph... You've grown bigger, but you're still a child in the head!
I make lunches for my sisters, too...
Because he's perfect as the hero of the hot-blooded boys' manga I'm drawing!
All right! The Nahel Argama will descend to Gulfer's home planet! All units, follow us!
Heh... Even so, I have no intention of apologizing to you.
......About that, actually......
No, it's the opposite. #男愛称 is alive.
But that is the sin and fate of the people of Arctos, who created Gulfer...
Ruri...
Brother, aren't you the one who is mistaken... who has been deceived!?
Oh... Rubina... Why can't you understand my thinking...?
But... I haven't reported this incident to the military yet.
How did he find out about #機体名?
#男愛称, I've brought parts for your body... and TE Absorber Unit 8.
#男愛称, I've brought parts for your body... and TE Absorber Unit 9.
Once #男愛称's repairs are finished, take it out for a shakedown.
...That's quite a harsh assessment.
Yes, leave it to me. I'll adjust you so you can move without medicine this time...
#男愛称... you'll be responsible for piloting this form.
Yes, your new #機体名.
Yes. Unlike before, you won't be a co-pilot...
Right. This is Form G... specialized for close-range and melee combat.
And this is Form G... specialized for close-range and melee combat.
In short, fewer engine problems mean you can concentrate more on combat.
Though all that actually changes is where Rouga and Hiou are attached.
The unit's adjustments are already complete.
I received a report about this incident.
I'm counting on your performance, Second Lieutenant #男姓名.
I'll arrange new medicine at once. It's improved, with no side effects. That should do for now.
The new #機体名 itself transforms between two forms.
The new #機体名 has an improved TE Engine.
Look. These are the specifications for the new unit.
They're normally attached to the base unit. Depending on their position and use...
They're normally attached at various points on the base unit. Depending on their position and use...
U-um... Please don't fight.
He wouldn't let us examine him, so we don't know his actual condition.
...Harry, please give the transport permission to land for now.
We... We can't let the ship sink here...!
There's no need for that.
Yes. Rain is giving him emergency treatment now.
I understand. We should be on guard, just in case.
...As you can see.
...I'll fetch his medicine. Please look after him for a while.
But we've finished emergency treatment... and he's regained consciousness.
Yeah, you're right... Let's check on him in intensive care...
Yeah. #女愛称 was in the rear seat, but...
Then try it! Let's see who wins: my fist, bearing others' hopes, or a villain like you!
He was in the front seat, yet he survived that impact...
Your fists, steeped in malice, are no match for me and Daimos!
What if that mechanical god appears from "outside"?
And the being that brings the out-of-control play to its close.
Don't you have any weapons!? A huge hammer, a guitar, anything!?
Even without the seventh, we've got to do something... We've got to defeat Gulfer!
Mom says he still hasn't woken up, so we don't really know...
And... once again, a deus ex machina was brought in to bring the play to its close.
Even so, I wanted to change things. To sever your ties to the past, too.
Some theories say it's the Shadow Mirror, the Ruina... or the Einst something...
...Anyway, all we can do now is pray he's safe...
Could that person be...
We must protect the T-Buster at all costs for Operation Doolittle!
Wasn't it the Guests or the Aerogaters?
You are RahXephon's rightful Instrumentalist... You were born that way.
